import os,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
projects=['iptvpn-bot','pink-iptv']
def git(p,*args,t=25):
 try:
  x=subprocess.run(['git','-c','safe.directory='+str(p),'-C',str(p),*args],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=t,env={**os.environ,'GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT':'0','GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS':'0'})
  return x.returncode,x.stdout.decode('utf8','replace').strip()
 except Exception as e:return -1,''
r={'read_only':True,'audit':'per-file worktree-vs-GitHub-main parity after safe fetch','projects':{}}
for n in projects:
 p=Path('/srv/projects')/n
 d={'source_root':str(p)}
 rc,head=git(p,'rev-parse','HEAD');d['head']=head if rc==0 else None
 rc,main=git(p,'rev-parse','refs/remotes/origin/main');d['remote_main']=main if rc==0 else None
 rc,dirty=git(p,'ls-files','-m'); paths=dirty.splitlines() if rc==0 else []
 d['dirty_tracked_count']=len(paths); d['dirty_vs_main']=[]
 for path in paths:
  q=p/path
  rc1,local=git(p,'hash-object','--',path,t=15) if q.is_file() and not q.is_symlink() else (1,'')
  rc2,remote=git(p,'rev-parse','refs/remotes/origin/main:'+path,t=15)
  d['dirty_vs_main'].append({'file':path,'same_content_as_main':rc1==0 and rc2==0 and local==remote,'present_in_main':rc2==0,'local_exists':q.is_file()})
 rc,up=git(p,'diff','--name-status','HEAD','refs/remotes/origin/main',t=65)
 d['upstream_name_status_count']=len(up.splitlines()) if rc==0 else None
 d['upstream_name_status_first_20']=[line[:160] for line in up.splitlines()[:20]]
 rc,u=git(p,'ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard')
 d['untracked_count']=len(u.splitlines()) if rc==0 else None
 d['main_ref_available']=bool(d['remote_main'])
 r['projects'][n]=d
print(json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True))
